records.title: Algorithm-Hardware Co-Design for Ultra-Low-Power Large Language Models
records.reason: DOI metadata and the University of Groningen record confirm the listed paper and IEEE venue, but the DOI resolver/IEEE primary abstract could not be retrieved in this session; algorithm and target benefit therefore remain unverified.

records.title: Polybasic Speculative Decoding Through a Theoretical Perspective
records.reason: The primary abstract presents a multi-model speculative-decoding theory and reports 3.31–4.43× inference speedups while preserving output distribution.

records.title: SmartTrim: Adaptive Tokens and Attention Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Models
records.reason: SmartTrim prunes redundant tokens and attention heads per input; its primary abstract reports 2–3× VLM acceleration, a direct inference-efficiency result.

records.title: Selective Rotary Position Embedding
records.reason: The primary arXiv record for Selective RoPE matches the distinctive rotary-embedding title fragment and describes improved gated-linear sequence models, but reports language/sequence quality rather than a serving-efficiency gain.

records.title: Reward-Guided Speculative Decoding for Efficient LLM Reasoning
records.reason: Reward-guided speculative decoding adaptively decides when to invoke the target model; its abstract reports up to 4.4× fewer FLOPs for reasoning inference.

records.title: [SoK] Systematizing Inference Placement for Deep Learning Across Edge and Cloud Platforms: A Multi-Objective Optimization Perspective
records.reason: The primary SoK abstract surveys model partitioning/offloading across device, edge, and cloud with inference latency, communication delay, and cost as explicit objectives.

records.title: Latency Adjustable Transformer Encoder for Language Understanding
records.reason: The primary abstract proposes adjustable Transformer inference cost through token pruning and reports latency gains on language models, including Llama 3 TTFT.

records.title: Neural Weight Compression for Language Models
records.reason: NWC learns codecs for LLM weights and evaluates accuracy-compression tradeoffs at 4–6 bits, directly targeting deployment memory and model size.

records.title: Learned Prefix Caching for Efficient LLM Inference
records.reason: The NeurIPS primary abstract introduces learned LLM prefix-cache eviction and reports smaller cache requirements and higher prefill throughput.

records.title: Higher-order Linear Attention
records.reason: HLA supplies a causal streaming attention mechanism with constant-size state and linear-time per-token computation, addressing long-context inference cost.

records.title: Speculative Decoding Meets Quantization: Compatibility Evaluation and Hierarchical Framework Design
records.reason: The primary abstract finds tree verification can erase 4-bit quantization gains and proposes hierarchical speculative decoding, reporting a 2.78× speedup.

records.title: BlindSight: Harnessing Sparsity for Efficient Vision-Language Models
records.reason: BlindSight uses an input-template-aware sparse-attention mask and Triton GPU kernel for multi-image VLM inference, with measured attention speedups.

records.title: DSDE: Dynamic Speculative Decoding with KLD Stability for Real-World Serving
records.reason: DSDE adapts speculative length from KLD stability signals and targets end-to-end latency and straggler behavior in LLM serving.

records.title: HyperDFlash: Hyper-Connection-Aligned Block Speculative Decoding with Gated Residual Reduction
records.reason: HyperDFlash is a block-parallel speculative-decoding framework aligned to MHC residual streams and reports higher accepted draft length and decoding speed.

records.title: Adjoint sharding for very long context training of state space models
records.reason: The primary abstract explicitly targets memory and runtime of very-long-context SSM training; the measured gains are training-only and do not establish inference/serving efficiency.

records.title: DPBERT: Efficient Inference for BERT based on Dynamic Planning
records.reason: DPBERT selects or bypasses Transformer layers per input and reports reduced BERT inference latency on GLUE.

records.title: MTraining: Distributed Dynamic Sparse Attention for Efficient Ultra-Long Context Training
records.reason: MTraining improves distributed dynamic-sparse-attention throughput for ultra-long-context model training; the abstract’s objective and measurements are training-specific.

records.title: Binary Neural Networks for Large Language Model: A Survey
records.reason: The primary survey covers binary/low-bit quantization techniques for LLMs and their resource-overhead reduction, a direct compression path for deployment.

records.title: The Markovian Thinker: Architecture-Agnostic Linear Scaling of Reasoning
records.reason: Markovian Thinking redesigns reasoning to linear compute and constant memory; this is inference-time reasoning cost reduction, but evidence is tied to a reasoning/RL environment rather than a serving runtime.

records.title: LiteKV: A KV cache compression method for efficient inference on resource-constrained devices
records.reason: LiteKV is a training-free three-ring KV-cache management strategy; its publisher abstract evaluates memory, computation, and long-context inference tradeoffs.
